description:
Outcome: Staff can provision approximately 80 individual accounts and run and verify the first version, from owner instructions and delegated operating choices.
Scope: Integrated acceptance matrix, account/timezone setup guide, backup/restore smoke procedure, production configuration checklist (external secrets, DEBUG off, allowed hosts, HTTPS/secure cookies) and supported server start/readiness command. Excludes: public deployment execution and invented load targets.
Acceptance: Evidence covers every authentication/booking rule and failure, concurrent slot/quota safety, eight-date navigation, clean setup and a repeatable two-account demo; production configuration is documented before real use.
Behaviour: Recovery guidance for lock contention, booking conflicts and legacy ownership mapping; no secrets in documentation.
Verification: make test integrated regressions; documented restore and keyboard walkthrough during implementation, never during Storybloq setup. Prerequisites: Live availability, booking and cancellation screens. Assumptions: Hosting remains undecided and does not block a local first version; proposed server command python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000 with login-page readiness must be established.
title: Acceptance evidence and staff operating guide
